record.nl_statement: Use induction to prove ∑_{k=0}^{n} (n choose k) = 2^n. That is, the sum of the nth row of Pascal’s Triangle is 2^n.
record.difficulty_rationale: A finite binomial-sum identity; source asks for induction. Rating is provisional and pending rubric review.
record.expected_lean_statement: theorem pascal_row_sum (n : ℕ) : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), Nat.choose n k = 2 ^ n
